summary: CRT-style file seek/tell. Validates that the state flags at a1+0xC have bits 0x83 set (open/writeable) and the seek mode a3 is <= 2; on the valid path it clears bit 0x10 of the flags, adds the current position (sub_58AD08) to the offset when a3 == 1 (seek relative to current), flushes buffered writes via BufferFlushWrite, and after a write-state check either sets the internal buffer size at a1+0x18 to 512 or clears the low two flag bits. The OS seek sub_58C724 on the handle at a1+0x10 returns the final position, mapped to 0 on success and -1 on failure. The invalid path sets errno via TLSOffsetGetter to 22 (EINVAL) and returns -1.

local_names.v3: file state flags at a1+0xC, read and conditionally masked
local_names.v4: seek origin selector forwarded to the OS seek
local_names.v5: re-read file state flags used to decide buffer-size vs write-state handling

operations.description: Read the file state flags v3 from a1+0xC as the first condition input.
Guard on the file state and seek mode: (v3 & 0x83) != 0 and a3 <= 2 must both hold to enter the seek path.
Clear bit 0x10 of the state flags: LOBYTE(v3) = v3 & 0xEF, written back to a1+0xC.
Guard on the seek mode a3 == 1: when relative-to-current, add the current file position to the offset.
sub_58AD08(a1) reads the current file position (tell) and adds it to a2; v4 is set to 0 for this case.
BufferFlushWrite(a1) flushes buffered data before the OS seek executes.
Re-read v5 from a1+0xC; when (v5 & 0x80) == 0, and bits 0x1 and 0x8 are set while bit 0x400 is clear, set the internal buffer size at a1+0x18 to 512.
When (v5 & 0x80) != 0, clear the low two flag bits: LOBYTE(v5) = v5 & 0xFC, written back to a1+0xC.
sub_58C724(handle at a1+0x10, a2, v4) performs the OS seek; the comparison (result != -1) - 1 yields 0 on success and -1 on failure.
Return the seek result: 0 on success, -1 on OS failure.
On the invalid path (file not open or a3 > 2), set errno to 22 via the TLS offset getter.
Invoked by the locked position-query wrapper sub_587F64.
